# `passportsim doctor`

Report the bundled ROM pins, any ROM override and every corpus entry.

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| Caps group | `core` |
| MCP tool | `passport_doctor` |
| HTTP route | `POST /v1/instances/{id}/commands/doctor` |
| Scenario step | none |
| CLI aliases | none |
| Annotations | `read_only`, `idempotent`, `native_only` |

## Hosts

The matrix below is the full one; this page is byte-identical on every host.

| macOS | Windows | Browser |
|---|---|---|
| yes | yes | no |

## Synopsis

```text
passportsim doctor --json <@file|->
```

## Arguments

| Argument | Form | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `report` | carried by `--json` | `object` | yes | What native discovery found (pemu_host::assets::discovery_report). |

A nested object or array is passed as one JSON document with `--json @<file>` or `--json -`; it has no flag of its own.

Input schema: [`docs/schema/commands/doctor.input.json`](../schema/commands/doctor.input.json).

## Output

Output schema: [`docs/schema/commands/doctor.output.json`](../schema/commands/doctor.output.json).
TypeScript types: `web/src/gen/commands/doctor.d.ts` (`DoctorArgs`, `DoctorResult`).

## Errors

| Code | Number |
|---|---|
| `E_USAGE` | 1 |
| `E_ASSET_MISSING` | 13 |
| `E_ASSET_HASH` | 14 |
| `E_INTERNAL` | 17 |

Every code is listed in [`docs/errors.md`](../errors.md).

## Examples

### Check the bundled ROM pins and the corpus

```sh
passportsim doctor --json - <<'JSON'
{
  "report": {
    "bundled_roms": [],
    "corpus": []
  }
}
JSON
```

```powershell
@'
{
  "report": {
    "bundled_roms": [],
    "corpus": []
  }
}
'@ | passportsim doctor --json -
```
